sources.quote: Pi Piscium, also named Idigna, is a spectroscopic binary star in the zodiac constellation of Pisces.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 5.565 times the Sun's luminosity at 6,699 K, so 1.754 solar radii.
